tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a new agent profile under agents/<name>/ by copying the chosen skill folders from the skill library. Sets an optional core-tool allowlist.

name.description: Agent name. Normalized to lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

description.description: Short description of what the agent is for.

skills.description: Skill folder names from the library (skills/) to copy into the agent.

core_tools.description: Optional allowlist of built-in core tool names (e.g. read_file, write_file). Omit to enable all core tools.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing agent of the same name.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all agent profiles with their description and skill count.

tools.name: show_agent
tools.description: Show one agent profile: description, model, core tools, and enabled skills.

tools.name: add_agent_skill
tools.description: Copy one skill folder from the library into an existing agent.

skill.description: Skill folder name from the library to add.

tools.name: remove_agent_skill
tools.description: Remove one copied skill folder from an agent.

skill.description: Skill folder name to remove from the agent.

tools.name: set_agent_core_tools
tools.description: Set an agent's core-tool allowlist. Omit core_tools to enable all core tools.

core_tools.description: Allowlist of core tool names, or empty/omitted for all.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Delete an agent profile and its copied skills. Cannot be undone.
